demos.name: Token Workbench
demos.description: Mock-only token workbench: decode and trace a token, test wrong-token rejection, check stub authorization servers against OAuth rules (FAPI 2.0 pack UNVERIFIED), compare PAR/RAR/DPoP/mTLS/JAR/PKCE (simulation).
demos.notes: Merges plan items C2 (token-flow comparison), C20 (OAuth profile checker) and C23 (wrong-token tester); the shelf takes one catalogId per demo, so C2 is used and the C20 and C23 'planned' cards stay. Host-run: npm install && npm run build && npm start (port 5910; npm run doctor checks it; stubs need 5911-5916). Or: docker compose up --build -d (publishes 127.0.0.1:5910 only; HOST_PORT changes it, and the shelf's Start button does not set HOST_PORT). Edit composeFile to this checkout's absolute path.
